'''Honwoo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] living in [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

He owned a [[Honwoo's repair shop|repair shop]] on [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] and employed [[Mathus]] as an assistant for many [[Standard year/Legends|years]], until the [[Human/Legends|Human]] left to work for [[Teemo/Legends|Teemo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. When Mathus attempted to leave his newfound job, Teemo threatened Honwoo's life if he quit.<ref name="Folio" />
